title: SWF: blend mode encoding in PlaceObject2
description: Flash 8 supports 14 blend modes (Normal, Layer, Multiply, Screen, Lighten, Darken, Difference, Add, Subtract, Invert, Alpha, Erase, Overlay, HardLight). In SWF v8+, PlaceObject2 (tag 26) was extended to PlaceObject3 (tag 70) which includes blend mode. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts and packages/swf/src/place.ts — does blendMode get encoded? If SymbolInstance has a blendMode property, encode it in PlaceObject3 (tag 70) with the HasBlendMode flag. Map Flash blend mode names to SWF uint8 values (Normal=0, Layer=2, Multiply=4, etc.). Add unit tests.
